name: Computer Point Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Computer Point Ltd is in the business of providing software training services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
Company promotes skill based knowledge in the field of computer education and runs its franchisee in the rural areas through which it carries out its educational business. Its products are used in various Industries including institutions and universities. At present, company is also trading in HL Fabrics & Others
